welcome.greeting: Namaste! Welcome to the Vridhi-ID Assistance Portal.
welcome.description: Vridhi-ID is an accessible, voice-first platform empowering elderly pensioners to complete their Digital Life Certificate (DLC) verification seamlessly in their preferred language.
welcome.askChangeLanguage: Would you like to change the language?
welcome.voiceHint: You can say 'Yes' or 'No', or tap the buttons below.

auth.title: Pensioner Secure Login
auth.subtitle: Access using your registered mobile number
auth.mobileLabel: Enter or speak your 10-digit mobile number
auth.otpSent: A 6-digit verification OTP has been dispatched to your mobile.

dashboard.title: Pensioner Service Hub
dashboard.optionADesc: Initiate a fresh certificate application with facial liveness and voice verification.
dashboard.optionBDesc: Inspect approved digital certificates and download your official PDF record.

form.title: Enter Pension Details
form.subtitle: Speak or type your pension particulars
form.name: Pensioner Full Name
form.consent: I hereby give voluntary consent for biometric processing of my face and voice for identification verification.

verification.title: AI Biometric Verification
verification.subtitle: Secure multi-factor evaluation via camera and microphone
verification.cameraDesc: Please look directly at the camera in a well-lit environment.
verification.voiceDesc: Press the mic and say: 'Yes, I am verifying my life certificate'.
verification.evaluating: AI models are evaluating biometric signals in real time...
verification.passedDesc: Face liveness, speaker match, and active challenges satisfied.
verification.reviewTitle: Case Routed for Human Officer Review
